requirements.desc: Normal active-flow resolution must remain registry-based and must not use broad `scanAllFlows()` recovery discovery when starting or continuing `/senti.flow`.
requirements.note: R1: normal active-flow status ignores recovery discovery candidates

requirements.desc: `senti flow resume` must act as explicit recovery discovery and classify active, stale, finalized, orphan worktree, and branch-only candidates separately from normal active flows.
requirements.note: R2: resume discovery classifies recovery candidate states

requirements.desc: `senti flow resume --spec <specId>` must select a displayed recovery candidate only when that candidate has a usable `runId` and execution root; candidates without both values must be display-only and blocked from normal continuation.
requirements.note: R3: resume --spec selects only candidates with runId and execution root

requirements.desc: Continuation after resume recovery must run from the selected candidate execution root and verify the selected `runId` before status, next-action, or run command execution can proceed; a mismatched target must return `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` before step execution.
requirements.note: R4: guarded continuation rejects mismatched runId before command work

requirements.desc: `senti.flow-resume` must stop presenting unqualified `/senti.flow` re-entry and must instead show execution-root plus `runId` guarded continuation commands when both values exist, or safe-stop instructions when either value is missing.
requirements.note: R5: resume output provides execution-root guarded guidance or safe-stop guidance

requirements.desc: Migration parity must be verified for retained public surfaces: resume discovery, resume selection, normal active-flow status, target-aware status, next-action, run continuation, resolve-context, active-flow registry, and skill guidance.
requirements.note: R6: recovery discovery does not register display-only candidates as active flows

requirements.desc: At least one e2e worktree recovery case must verify real git-worktree discovery and separation from normal active-flow resolution.
requirements.note: R7: worktree recovery candidate is selectable from its execution root

requirements.desc: Recovery discovery must keep bounded resource usage by preserving the `SCAN_FLOWS_LIMIT` candidate cap and limiting traversal to local specs, registered git worktrees, and `feature/*` branches.
requirements.note: R8: recovery discovery reports candidate cap and truncation state
